set.acceptance: Go tests in internal/ciworkflow (go test -trimpath ./internal/ciworkflow/...) parse .github/workflows/ci.yml and assert: a `changes` job with an output code, set true on workflow_dispatch and on pull_request computed as ci-model-only-since-green's acceptance describes; lint, scripts, api, rest and budgets each needing changes with if on code == 'true'; a `model` job needing changes with if on code == 'false' that runs make self-check and `go test -trimpath ./internal/op -run TestEveryFieldInRepoLogIsKnown` (so a model-only PR whose log carries a field op.FieldKnown rejects still fails CI, as it does today through the api/rest jobs); check needing changes, model and the five Go jobs, if: always(), failing unless changes succeeded and every other result is success or skipped, and failing when none of model and the five Go jobs succeeded (an all-skipped run fails check); the existing triggers, concurrency, matrices and cache checks still pass. make check is unchanged. The change set's own PR touches Go code so runs everything; the next model-only PR's CI completes in a few minutes with check green, read from gh run view.
set.statement: On a pull request CI can run only a `model` job (setup-go, make self-check, then `go test -trimpath ./internal/op -run TestEveryFieldInRepoLogIsKnown`, the one Go test that reads the repo's own .rhiza/log and fails on a node field this commit's code does not know, which neither fold nor rhiza check validates) and skip lint, scripts, api, rest and budgets, decided by a first `changes` job with an output code (code=false selects the model job, code=true the five Go jobs; always true on workflow_dispatch); when a pull request's code is false is the decision rule of ci-model-only-since-green. Every dispatched run on main runs everything as today, and the aggregate `check` job, needing changes, model and the five Go jobs with if: always(), fails unless changes succeeded and passes only when every other job is success or skipped with at least one of them succeeded.
